expectations.text: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is exactly https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic (not /api/paas/v4, not /api/coding/paas/v4, not api.z.ai)
expectations.evidence: settings.json: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic（海外 api.z.ai 只作为备注）

expectations.text: The key is supplied via ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (Claude Code's bearer-token variable), not only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
expectations.evidence: settings.json 使用 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN，并解释了不用 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 的原因

expectations.text: Model aliases are mapped with ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL = glm-5.3 and ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL = glm-5.3-flash (or an equivalent mapping using real GLM model codes)
expectations.evidence: opus/sonnet 映射 glm-5.3 正确，但 haiku/small-fast 映射为 glm-4.5-air——该模型不在 Coding Plan 支持列表（官方仅 glm-5.3 / glm-5.3-flash，旧代码自动路由列表里也没有 4.5-air），套餐 Key 请求它大概率失败；agent 自己也承认模型名'凭记忆写、未验证'

expectations.text: The response says the key must be created on the Coding Plan page (bigmodel.cn/coding-plan/personal/overview or the team plan page), and that standard platform API keys / team keys are not interchangeable with it
expectations.evidence: response.md 第 30 行：'Coding Plan 开通后在 bigmodel.cn 控制台“API Keys”里生成'——与官方'在个人编程套餐 > 套餐概览新建 API Key'、'团队套餐 Key 与平台其他 API Key 不通用'相反

expectations.text: Config is valid JSON placed under the "env" key of settings.json (or an equivalent shell export block), with no invented variable names
expectations.evidence: settings.json 为合法 JSON，env 下变量名均为 Claude Code 真实变量（含额外的 ANTHROPIC_MODEL / CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL）

notes: 端点和变量名基本正确，但 Key 来源写错、haiku 档映射到套餐外模型，用户照抄会在 haiku 档调用时踩坑。
